carefulharvest.config.title: Careful Harvest
carefulharvest.config.nonSneakingBreak.t: Drop when a player breaks a plant without sneaking (with any item).
carefulharvest.config.fluids.tooltip: Drop when water flows onto a plant. (Lava never drops anything, as in vanilla.)
carefulharvest.config.explosions.tooltip: Drop when an explosion destroys a plant.
carefulharvest.config.supportBroken.tool: Drop when a plant pops off because the block below it was removed (by anyone, including a sneaking player).
carefulharvest.config.other.tooltip: Drop for every other cause: pistons, enderman deaths, other mods, ...
carefulharvest.config.exemptSoil: Exempt soil (one block id or #tag per line)
carefulharvest.config.exemptSoil.tooltip: Plants standing on these blocks are not affected by Careful Harvest at all.
carefulharvest.config.status.ok: Done saves and applies here. Servers use their own file.
carefulharvest.config.status.remote: Connected to a server: this edits only your local config file.
